item.title: Amazon to buy Decart's AI chip optimization tech in latest AI talent grab
item.description: Tech giants are increasingly buying the capabilities needed to advance their AI ambitions instead of building them in-house, as competition at the frontier of AI development intensifies.

item.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia return sparks relief for battered AI trade, but questions remain
item.description: Huang's reinstatement atop the semiconductor giant halted a slide in technology shares that had sent the benchmark S&P 500 into a correction, though there was also some caution that his second coming may raise new risks for the company and industry.

item.title: Nvidia and board still face legal risks after Jensen Huang's return
item.description: The reported ties between Huang and a suspected spy led to his resignation as CEO and sparked investigations by the US securities regulator and FBI, congressional hearings, a review by the company's independent directors and a proposed investor class action lawsuit.

item.title: "When elephants dance, everyone moves to give space": Uday Kotak on Huang's reinstatement
item.description: Industrialist Uday Kotak has described Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia's Chief Executive Officer as one of the most consequential decisions in the history of global markets, saying the move has coincided with the recovery of USD 1 trillion in Nvidia's market capitalisation and USD 4 trillion across the US market.

item.title: Questions linger after Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
item.description: Jensen Huang's surprise return to Nvidia on Monday appeared to stabilize the US chip giant, along with the broader stock market and AI ecosystem, but questions linger about the longterm impact of his scandal. - Will Huang's return stabilize the market?
